title: Please Help Me
goal: Ask another person for basic help.

patterns.tagalog: Puwede mo ba akong tulungang hanapin ito?
patterns.english: Can you help me find this?

patterns.tagalog: Puwede mo ba akong tulungang dalhin ito?
patterns.english: Can you help me carry this?

objectives.description: Ask someone to help you find something.
Ask someone to help you carry something.

scenarios.title: Asking for basic help
scenarios.setup: You are having trouble with something and need another person's help.
scenarios.learnerGoal: Get the person's attention and ask for help.

scenarios.title: Finding something
scenarios.setup: You cannot find an item in a store or unfamiliar place.
scenarios.learnerGoal: Ask someone to help you find it.
targets: Puwede mo ba akong tulungang hanapin ito?

scenarios.title: Carrying something
scenarios.setup: You have something difficult to carry by yourself.
scenarios.learnerGoal: Ask someone to help you carry it.
targets: Puwede mo ba akong tulungang dalhin ito?
